:::{#sol-flat-point-minimum}

Evaluate $f$ there:

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(2) &= 4 - 8 + 7 \\
&= 3
\end{aligned}
$$

is the minimum of the values of $f$.
Completing the square, $f(w) = (w - 2)^2 + 3$,
since

$$
\begin{aligned}
(w - 2)^2 + 3 &= w^2 - 4w + 4 + 3 \\
&= w^2 - 4w + 7,
\end{aligned}
$$

and $(w - 2)^2 \ge 0$, so $f(w) \ge 3 = f(2)$ for every $w$.
Equivalently, the derivative is negative below $w = 2$ and positive above it,
so the function falls into that point and rises out of it.

:::
